settings.heading: Corporate Gifting, Made Effortless
settings.subtitle: Thank clients, celebrate employees, and mark every milestone with thoughtfully curated gift baskets your recipients will actually love. Boozy or alcohol-free, personalized to your brand.

settings.content: Tell us about your team, your occasion, and your budget — our gifting specialists will help you build the perfect order, big or small.

settings.title: Get Personalized Support
settings.content: Not sure where to start? Our gifting team is here to help. Tell us who you're celebrating and what you have in mind, and we'll recommend the perfect baskets, handle the details, and make sure every gift lands beautifully.

settings.title: Build It Yourself
settings.content: Already know what you want? Browse our full range of baskets, bottles, and treats to create a custom corporate gift. Personalize it with engraving, tailor it to their taste, and add your company swag — boozy or alcohol-free, the choice is yours.

Sending gifts to a whole team or client list? We'll build you a private, branded gifting portal — your logo, your curated selection, your budget. Your recipients pick what they love, and we handle packing, personalization, and delivery to every address.

settings.title: Bulk & Custom Corporate Orders
settings.content:
Need to send gifts to a group? We make it simple. Place a single order for your whole list and we'll take care of the rest — personalized messages, scheduled delivery, and tracking, all handled for you.

✓ One order, as many recipients as you need

✓ Physical gift baskets or digital gift links recipients can redeem

✓ A personalized message on every gift

✓ Deliveries scheduled up to 8 weeks in advance

✓ Custom branded portal available for ongoing programs

settings.title: Ship to Many Addresses
settings.content: Check out to one place and we'll handle delivery to every recipient on your list.

settings.title: Custom Engraving
settings.content: Add personalized engraving to wine and spirit bottles for an extra-special touch.

settings.title: Your Brand, Your Way
settings.content: Add your company logo or swag to any gift basket for a branded finish.

settings.title: Hands-On Support
settings.content: Our gifting team makes ordering easy from start to finish.

settings.title: Reliable Shipping
settings.content: We deliver your corporate gifts where and when they're needed.

settings.title: Alcohol-Free Options
settings.content: Plenty of alcohol-free baskets so there's something for everyone on your list.

settings.title: We can do it all
settings.content: From large orders of curated gift baskets to one-off custom gifts featuring your logo and promotional items — if it's a memorable business gift you're after, you're in the right place.

settings.title: What type of corporate gifts do you offer?
settings.content: We offer curated, personalized gifts for employees, clients, and events — from engraved bottles and standalone treats to fully customized gift baskets with a selection of goodies for any taste. Boozy or alcohol-free, we'll help you find the perfect fit.

settings.title: Can I add our company branding to the gifts?
settings.content: Absolutely. We can swap in unbranded items and add your company logo to the gift baskets at no extra cost. Your recipients will love a gift personalized with your brand.

settings.title: How long will shipping take?
settings.content: Shipping times vary by destination. We work with major carriers to offer ground, two-day, and overnight options. Ground shipping typically takes 1–5 days depending on location — you'll see exact estimates at checkout.

settings.title: Can I ship to multiple addresses within one transaction?
settings.content: Yes! Get in touch with our gifting team before or after your order with your list of addresses, and we'll make sure each gift reaches the right person. Just check out as if shipping to one location, and we'll handle the rest.

settings.title: What if we don’t know all recipients’ addresses?
settings.content: No problem. If you don't have every address yet, just gather them and send them to our gifting team in time for us to ship. It's that easy.

settings.title: FAQs
settings.support_hours: Our customer support is available Monday to Friday: 8am-8:30pm.
